ai.seo_question: What is the source of the Prophet's message according to Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (53:3) serves as a direct rebuttal to the Quraysh's claim that Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was merely a poet or soothsayer, affirming that his speech is identical to divine revelation. It underscores the infallibility of the Prophet's communication, linking his words closely to the Quranic text itself. This distinction is crucial for establishing the authority of the Sunnah as a source of legislation alongside the Quran.
